headline: Short-period SSE junk on an onshore — leave it.
today: Size looks tempting to 3.2ft but it's short-period SSE and the wind is onshore SW most of the day. Windswell slop, not worth the trip. If you're local, maybe a dawn poke before it fully deteriorates, otherwise skip.

daysToWatch.note: Prime SE angle, cleaner at 1.1 to 1.4ft with cross wind. Small but organized — log it if you're nearby.
Prime ESE angle with solid N offshore all day, though short period keeps it around 2ft. Cleanest window of the week here.
